name: contextual-help
description: Design, build and review contextual help: tooltips that earn their place, inline hints, empty states that teach, onboarding and error messages with a way out.

plugins.name: contextual-help
plugins.description: Decides where an interface needs help and where it needs a better label instead, picks the lightest form (hint, toggletip, empty state, just-in-time tip, checklist), writes it short, wires it for keyboard, touch and screen readers, ships tested React components, and reviews existing help with prioritized plans.
